Subhadrā
------------------------------------------
Subhadrā was the daughter of Vasudeva and देवकी, and the younger sister of कृष्ण.
Arjuna, the Pāṇḍava hero, and सुभद्रा were in love with each other. Since बलराम, the elder brother of कृष्ण was against their मर्रिअगे, कृष्ण worked out a stratagem by which they eloped. Later on they were married.
Abhimanyu was her son. He was an extraordinarily brave warrior and was ruthlessly killed by the Kauravas by unethical means, in the कुरुक्षेत्र war.
After the war, she went to द्वारका to live with her brothers.
She is one of the three deities worshipped in the Jagannāth temple at पुरी (in Orissa).
See also ABHIMANYU and ARJUNA.
